tree: Collect, organize and analyze customer feedback from every touchpoint. Turn insights into real improvements and deliver a better customer experience with Noxtill.
Collect feedback from multiple channels and turn it into actionable insights.
Collect feedback via surveys, website, email, QR codes and more.
Get instant notifications when customers share their thoughts.
Understand how customers feel with AI-powered sentiment analysis.
Discover common themes and improvement opportunities.
Assign feedback, create tasks and close the loop with your team.
Turn feedback into a better customer experience.
Noxtill helps you gather customer feedback at every touchpoint — from post-purchase surveys to on-site forms, QR codes and more.
Capture feedback directly on your website.
Monitor and collect feedback from social platforms.
Simple and beautiful feedback experience for your customers.
Use powerful analytics to find trends, common topics and areas for improvement. Make data-driven decisions that help you grow your business.
"Amazing service and great product quality! Highly recommended."
"Delivery was a bit late, but the support team was very helpful."
"The product arrived damaged. Need better packaging."
Connect multiple platforms and manage all your customer feedback in one place.
Turn Customer Feedback into Real Growth
Collect, analyze and act on customer feedback with Noxtill. Build better experiences and stronger relationships.
How Customer Feedback works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business collect and manage customer feedback?

Collect feedback through surveys and the channels customers already use, bring it together in Noxtill and review it in one place. The customer feedback collection tool organizes and analyzes responses, so customer feedback tracking software shows trends you can act on.
How does Customer Feedback software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

It shows what customers really think and where the experience needs work. When comparing a feedback management platform for small business, customer satisfaction feedback software or a feedback survey management tool, check collection channels, survey options, analysis and links to customer records.
